paper_title: Predictions for Axion Couplings from ALP Cogenesis
suggested_experiment_name: CAST2017 + HB stars (ALP cogenesis paper Fig.1)
notes: This is a theoretical paper predicting ALP couplings (to photons, nucleons, electrons) as a function of ALP mass from a cogenesis mechanism. It does not present a new experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection; the plots show theoretical prediction bands (green bands) overlaid with existing constraints (CAST, HB, ADMX, neutron star cooling, etc.) and future sensitivities from other experiments. The prediction band for gaγγ follows Eq. (3.10): |gaγγ| ≈ 1.8e-11 GeV^-1 * caγγ * (ma/meV)^(1/2), but this is a model prediction, not an exclusion limit.
